```{=html}
<div id="map-aug06" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug06').setView([35.0975, 129.0400], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 L7 Haeundae by Lotte Hotels', lat:35.1620, lng:129.1601, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=L7+Haeundae+by+Lotte+Hotels+Busan' },
    { name:'Gamcheon Culture Village 🎨', lat:35.0975, lng:129.0147, c:'#E53935', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gamcheon+Culture+Village+Busan' },
    { name:'BIFF Square 🎬', lat:35.1010, lng:129.0280, c:'#1565C0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=BIFF+Square+Busan' },
    { name:'Jagalchi Market 🦀', lat:35.0968, lng:129.0301, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jagalchi+Market+Busan' },
    { name:'Songdo Cable Car 🚡', lat:35.0853, lng:129.0131, c:'#AB47BC', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Songdo+Beach+Cable+Car+Busan' },
    { name:'Oryukdo Skywalk 🌁', lat:35.0817, lng:129.1208, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Oryukdo+Skywalk+Busan' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="section-header">Morning — Gamcheon Village</div>

<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-06T09:30" data-lat="35.0975" data-lng="129.0147">
  <div class="event-time">09:30</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🎨 Village</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Gamcheon Culture Village</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Busan's "Santorini" — a hillside village of pastel-painted houses, winding alleys, murals, and art installations. Originally a poor neighbourhood, now a must-visit creative district. Best in morning before afternoon crowds.
      <ul>
        <li>Pick up a map at the village info centre (stamp rally available)</li>
        <li>Look for the Little Prince statue — iconic photo spot</li>
        <li>Wear comfortable shoes — it's hilly</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gamcheon+Culture+Village+Busan" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Gamcheon</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/감천문화마을" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="section-header">Lunch</div>

<div class="event-card meal" data-dt="2026-08-06T12:00" data-lat="35.1010" data-lng="129.0280">
  <div class="event-time">12:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag meal">🎬 Lunch</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">BIFF Square — Street Food</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Busan International Film Festival's home street is lined with film star handprints and great street food stalls. Try:
      <ul>
        <li>씨앗 호떡 (Ssiat Hotteok) — Busan's signature seed-filled hotteok, crispy and caramelised</li>
        <li>Soondae (blood sausage) with tteok</li>
        <li>Eomuk (fish cake) skewers with broth</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=BIFF+Square+Nampo+Busan" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 BIFF Square</a>

</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="section-header">Afternoon — Jagalchi & Songdo</div>

<div class="event-card afternoon" data-dt="2026-08-06T14:00" data-lat="35.0968" data-lng="129.0301">
  <div class="event-time">14:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🦀 Market</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Jagalchi Fish Market</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Korea's largest seafood market — a Busan institution. Rows of live sea creatures: abalone, sea cucumber, flounder, crab, and more. The market women (자갈치아지매) are legendary. You can buy fish upstairs and have it prepared for you to eat on-site.
      <ul>
        <li>Go to the upper floors for sit-down fresh fish meals</li>
        <li>Haggling is expected</li>
        <li>Morning is busiest but afternoon still lively</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jagalchi+Market+Busan" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Jagalchi</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/자갈치시장" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="event-card afternoon" data-dt="2026-08-06T16:00" data-lat="35.0853" data-lng="129.0131">
  <div class="event-time">16:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🚡 Cable Car</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Songdo Beach Cable Car</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Glass-bottomed gondolas above a dramatic rocky coastline — connects Songdo Beach to Amnam Park. 1.6km over the sea, ~10 min each way. Stunning views over the Busan coastline and islands.</div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Songdo+Beach+Cable+Car+Busan" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Songdo Cable Car</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/송도해상케이블카" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
